name: engineering-units
description: Engineering unit conversion from exact definitions: pressure (psi, ksi, bar, inH2O, kgf/cm²), energy, power (hp, BTU/h, refrigeration tons), force, torque, flow (gpm, cfm, L/min), speed, density and angular speed. Converts text like "30 psi to bar". Zero dependencies, tested.
author: David Mashiah (https://davidmashiah.com)
